title: Mobility Visit Coverage by Week
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:checkin visit_type=* visits_completed=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(visits_completed) as metric by _time visit_type
| sort 0 _time visit_type
description: Trends monthly completed visits by visit type for weekly support coverage.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether weekly support coverage are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `visit_type` on `care:checkin` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly completed visits.
visualization: Line chart of monthly completed visits by visit type.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how completed visits changes month by month for each visit type so you can see whether weekly support coverage are heading the right way.
